verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these seven underlying tendencies.

verses.pali: Kāmarāgānusayo, paṭighānusayo, diṭṭhānusayo, vicikicchānusayo, mānānusayo, bhavarāgānusayo, avijjānusayo—
verses.english: The underlying tendencies of sensual desire, aversion, views, doubt, conceit, desire for continued existence, and ignorance.
These are the seven underlying tendencies.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, sattannaṁ anusayānaṁ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya …pe… ayaṁ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo”ti.
verses.english: The noble eightfold path should be developed for the direct knowledge, complete understanding, finishing, and giving up of these seven underlying tendencies.”
